# Trump poll finds most states disapprove of his job performance

El Paso Times

Most states disapprove of President Donald Trump’s job performance, including Texas.

According to an approval tracker from The Economist and YouGov, Trump’s net job approval rating in Texas is -22, meaning his disapproval rating is 22 percentage points higher than his approval rating.

Texas is far from alone.

# Trump approval rating still hovering near record lows, new poll shows

Portrait of Fernando Cervantes Jr.

Despite a slight improvement in the polls for President Donald Trump, his approval rating continues to hover near record lows in a new survey released by The Economist/YouGov on Aug. 25.

The poll found that 36% of Americans approved of Trump’s performance, a 1 percentage point improvement from last week’s The Economist/YouGov poll.
